before_start: Read this file and run `git log --oneline -20`.
Select exactly one task with status `pending` and the highest available priority whose dependencies are all `done`.
Confirm the selected task's `start_condition` is true before making code changes.
during_work: Work only on the selected task.
Stay inside the task boundary and do not pull in later tasks while working.
Do not modify code unrelated to the current task unless it is strictly required to make the selected task pass its verification.
before_finish: Run every step in `test_steps` for the selected task.
Change `status` to `done` only after all listed test steps succeed.
Write a short execution note in `progress.md` describing what changed, what was tested, and any follow-up risk.
Do not delete tasks or rewrite their scope; only update task `status`.

in_scope: PostgreSQL for business data and server sessions.
Personal workspace auto-created on first login.
One Kanban board per project with default columns.
One Gantt timeline per project backed by the same tasks as the board.
Tasks support title, description, status, priority, start date, and due date.
Task dependencies are included in the Gantt view.

testing: Manual browser verification for frontend tasks unless a task explicitly requires an automated test

tasks.start_condition: The repo has no committed ignore rules for Node, Java, env, or build output.
acceptance_criteria: A root `.gitignore` exists and covers Node modules, Maven `target/` output, IDE files, logs, and `.env` files.
test_steps: Run `git check-ignore -v frontend/node_modules backend/target .env` and confirm matching ignore rules are reported once those paths exist.

tasks.start_condition: There is no shared formatting baseline across frontend and backend files.
acceptance_criteria: A root `.editorconfig` exists with UTF-8, LF, final newline, and sensible indent rules for TypeScript, Java, YAML, and Markdown.
test_steps: Open `.editorconfig` and confirm the sections exist and are valid.

tasks.start_condition: There is no canonical place listing required environment variables.
acceptance_criteria: `.env.example` lists frontend origin, backend port, PostgreSQL connection values, session settings, and auth-related placeholders with no secrets.
test_steps: Open `.env.example` and confirm every variable needed by the architecture is present with placeholder values only.

tasks.start_condition: Local PostgreSQL is not defined in the repo.
acceptance_criteria: `docker-compose.yml` starts a Postgres container with a named volume and a health check.
test_steps: Run `docker compose up -d db` and confirm it starts successfully.
Run `docker compose ps` and confirm the database container becomes healthy.

tasks.start_condition: The repo does not explain how to start local infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: `README.md` explains the order for starting Postgres, backend, and frontend at a high level.
test_steps: Open `README.md` and confirm it references `docker-compose.yml`, `backend/`, and `frontend/`.

tasks.description: Scaffold the Spring Boot backend project.
tasks.start_condition: `backend/` does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: `backend/` exists as a Maven Spring Boot project targeting Java 21 with a runnable `TrackifyApplication` and Maven wrapper scripts.
test_steps: Run `./mvnw compile` inside `backend/` and confirm it succeeds.

tasks.start_condition: The backend project exists but does not include the full runtime stack.
acceptance_criteria: `pom.xml` includes Spring Web, Validation, Data JPA, PostgreSQL, Flyway, Spring Security, and Spring Session JDBC.
test_steps: Run `./mvnw dependency:tree` inside `backend/` and confirm it completes successfully.

tasks.start_condition: The backend has no app configuration aligned to the architecture.
acceptance_criteria: `application.yml` and `application-local.yml` exist with placeholders for datasource, session, auth, CORS origin, and server port.
test_steps: Open both YAML files and confirm the keys are present and profile separation is clear.

tasks.description: Add backend package skeleton and config classes.
tasks.start_condition: The backend has only the main application class.
acceptance_criteria: The `config/`, `common/`, `auth/`, `user/`, `workspace/`, `project/`, `task/`, `board/`, and `timeline/` package trees exist with placeholder config classes where needed.
test_steps: Run `./mvnw compile` and confirm it succeeds.

tasks.description: Add CORS config and a health endpoint.
tasks.start_condition: The backend cannot yet serve the frontend safely in local development and has no simple health probe.
acceptance_criteria: CORS is configured for the frontend origin and `GET /api/health` returns a simple JSON health payload.
test_steps: Run the app and call `curl http://localhost:8080/api/health` to confirm HTTP 200 with JSON.

tasks.start_condition: Backend errors use default Spring responses.
acceptance_criteria: A global exception handler returns one consistent JSON shape for validation, not found, and generic server errors.
test_steps: Add or run one small controller test that proves a handled exception returns the custom error shape.

tasks.description: Wire Flyway and a baseline migration.
tasks.start_condition: Database migrations are not yet part of backend startup.
acceptance_criteria: Flyway runs on startup and a baseline migration exists so the app can boot cleanly against the local database.
test_steps: With Postgres running, start the app with `./mvnw spring-boot:run` and confirm the logs show Flyway migration execution.

tasks.description: Scaffold the React + TypeScript frontend project.
tasks.start_condition: `frontend/` does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: `frontend/` exists as a Vite React TypeScript app and runs locally.
test_steps: Run `npm run build` inside `frontend/` and confirm it succeeds.

tasks.start_condition: The frontend app only has the default Vite dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: The frontend includes React Router, TanStack Query, Zustand, `@dnd-kit`, `gantt-task-react`, and `date-fns`.
test_steps: Run `npm install` and then `npm run build` inside `frontend/`, and confirm both succeed.

tasks.start_condition: The frontend file tree does not match the architecture.
acceptance_criteria: `src/app`, `src/pages`, `src/modules`, and `src/shared` exist with the planned subfolders and placeholder files.
test_steps: Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds, then verify the new folders are present on disk.

tasks.start_condition: The frontend still uses Vite starter styling.
acceptance_criteria: `tokens.css` and `globals.css` define a pastel minimal theme with green as the primary accent.
test_steps: Run the frontend and confirm the app renders with the new styles instead of the default Vite starter look.

tasks.start_condition: Theme tokens exist only as CSS files and are not wrapped in an app-level provider.
acceptance_criteria: `ThemeProvider.tsx` exists and is used by the app root to load the design tokens consistently.
test_steps: Run `npm run build` and confirm the provider is referenced from the bootstrap path.

tasks.start_condition: There is no shared server-state provider.
acceptance_criteria: `QueryProvider.tsx` creates the TanStack Query client and wraps the app.
test_steps: Run `npm run build` and confirm `QueryProvider` is referenced from the app root.

tasks.start_condition: The frontend has no route structure matching the architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Routes exist for sign-in, dashboard, board, timeline, and project settings, each with placeholder page components.
test_steps: Run the dev server and visit each route without runtime errors.

tasks.start_condition: Route placeholders exist but there is no shared layout or API client.
acceptance_criteria: `AuthLayout.tsx`, `AppShell.tsx`, and `shared/api/httpClient.ts` exist, and the HTTP client is configured to send credentials by default.
test_steps: Run `npm run build` and confirm `httpClient.ts` includes `credentials: "include"` or the equivalent client config.

tasks.start_condition: There is no persistent user table.
acceptance_criteria: A Flyway migration creates the `users` table with login, email, password hash, display name, and timestamps.
test_steps: Restart the backend and confirm the migration is applied successfully.

tasks.start_condition: The `users` table exists but the backend has no Java model for it.
acceptance_criteria: A `User` entity and repository exist in the `user` module.
test_steps: Run `./mvnw compile` and confirm it succeeds.

tasks.description: Add Spring Session JDBC tables and config.
tasks.start_condition: The backend can authenticate later, but session persistence is not configured.
acceptance_criteria: The project includes Spring Session JDBC configuration and the required session tables via migration or official schema import.
test_steps: With the app running, confirm the session tables exist in PostgreSQL.

tasks.description: Configure the Spring Security filter chain.
tasks.start_condition: The backend does not distinguish between public and protected routes.
acceptance_criteria: `/api/health` and the login endpoint are public, while protected API routes require authentication.
test_steps: Run a backend test that proves `/api/health` is public and `/api/me` is unauthorized before login.

tasks.start_condition: Authentication-related values live only as loose YAML keys.
acceptance_criteria: A typed config or properties class binds auth settings such as password policy or seed-user options used by the security setup.
test_steps: Run `./mvnw compile` and confirm the properties class is referenced from security setup.

tasks.start_condition: The app can authenticate later, but there is no logic for creating a user with a hashed password.
acceptance_criteria: A backend service can create a `User` record from login, email, display name, and password input while storing only a password hash.
test_steps: Add a unit test proving registration stores a password hash and rejects a duplicate login.

tasks.description: Implement login endpoint and session handling.
tasks.start_condition: The registration and credential services exist but are not connected to the sign-in flow.
acceptance_criteria: Successful login validates the submitted password, loads the matching user, and establishes the normal Spring-authenticated session.
test_steps: Add a backend test covering successful login and rejected login with an invalid password.

tasks.start_condition: Authenticated user state cannot be fetched by the frontend.
acceptance_criteria: `GET /api/me` returns the current signed-in user payload.
test_steps: Add a MockMvc test for authenticated and unauthenticated access.

tasks.start_condition: There is no explicit logout endpoint for the SPA.
acceptance_criteria: `POST /api/logout` invalidates the session and returns a simple success response.
test_steps: Add a test proving the session is invalidated after logout.

tasks.start_condition: The backend exposes auth endpoints, but the frontend has no session state layer.
acceptance_criteria: `modules/auth` contains types, API helpers, and `AuthProvider` bootstraps from `/api/me`.
test_steps: Run `npm run build` and confirm the app root wraps itself with `AuthProvider`.

tasks.start_condition: The auth module exists but there is no login UI.
acceptance_criteria: `SignInPage.tsx` renders a minimal branded sign-in screen with login and password inputs that submit to the backend login endpoint.
test_steps: Run the frontend and confirm the sign-in form submits login and password to the backend.

tasks.start_condition: Users can navigate to private pages without frontend gating.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated users are routed to sign-in, and authenticated users can enter the app shell.
test_steps: Manually load a protected route while signed out and confirm the redirect to the sign-in page.

tasks.start_condition: Users can exist, but workspaces do not.
acceptance_criteria: Schema, entity, and repository support `workspaces` and `workspace_members`.

tasks.start_condition: The frontend cannot ask which workspaces belong to the user.

tasks.start_condition: Workspaces exist but projects do not.

tasks.start_condition: There is no final acceptance checklist for the MVP.

tasks.description: Run the MVP smoke pass and fix the first blocking defect.
